about: Mahanadi Coalfields Limited is a Miniratna Category I public sector undertaking and a subsidiary of Coal India Limited. It is the largest single coal-producing company in India, accounting for 21.00% of domestic coal production in Fiscal 2026. The company operates 17 mines (14 opencast and 3 underground) primarily across the Talcher and Ib Valley coalfields in Odisha.

objects.purpose: Offer for Sale of equity shares by the Selling Shareholder and listing benefits

promoters.background: Coal India Limited is a Maharatna public sector undertaking and the largest coal-producing company in the world, contributing 73.8% of India's domestic coal production in Fiscal 2026.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers accounted for 55.94% of revenue from operations, and thermal power utilities accounted for 68.62% of product sales in Fiscal 2026.

litigation_note: Contingent liabilities represented 39.80% of Net Worth as of March 31, 2026 and 55.86% as of September 30, 2026, none of which have been provided for in financial statements.
strengths: Largest single coal producer in India, accounting for 21.00% of domestic coal output in Fiscal 2026.
Extensive audited JORC coal reserves of 9,840.31 MT, sufficient for around 45 years of production.
Wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India Limited, benefiting from its strategic support, technological access, and brand reputation.
Highly mechanised, low-cost opencast mining operations with 99.37% of coal produced via surface miners in Fiscal 2026.
Favourable rail-led evacuation network connected to three railway zones and five ports on the eastern coast.
Industry-leading operational profitability, delivering the highest EBITDA and PAT margins among Indian peer coal producers.
Stable revenue visibility backed by long-term Fuel Supply Agreements representing 82.12% of product sales in Fiscal 2026.

risks.title: High Customer Concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers accounted for 55.94% of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2026, creating vulnerability to customer loss or volume cuts.

risks.title: Dependence on Thermal Power Sector
risks.detail: Sales to the thermal power sector represented 68.62% of product sales in Fiscal 2026, exposing performance to power sector operational conditions.

risks.title: Product Concentration on Raw Non-Coking Coal
risks.detail: Raw non-coking coal generated 97.41% of sale of products in Fiscal 2026; any decline in demand directly threatens revenues.

risks.title: Significant Exposure to Government Utilities
risks.detail: Government-owned and controlled power companies contributed 44.81% of Fiscal 2026 revenue, creating exposure to receivable delays and regulatory scrutiny.

risks.title: Substantial Contingent Liabilities
risks.detail: Contingent liabilities stood at 39.80% of net worth as of March 31, 2026 (55.86% as of September 30, 2026) without financial provisioning.

risks.title: Contractor Concentration and Operational Dependence
risks.detail: Top 10 third-party contractors represented 60.02% of contractual expenses in Fiscal 2026, creating operational disruption risks.

risks.title: Surging Trade Receivables
risks.detail: Trade receivables rose by 73.30% between Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2026 despite revenue declining 3.43%, increasing credit risk.

risks.title: Expired Ground Water Abstraction Approvals
risks.detail: NOC renewal applications for mine dewatering across multiple operational opencast mines were pending, carrying risks of environmental penalties.

notes: Financials for FY24, FY25, and FY26 are restated consolidated figures; six-month stub periods ended September 30, 2025 and 2026 have been excluded from financial arrays. Issue is 100% Offer for Sale.
